title: Follow heartbeat phases in strict order, every session
body: Read MISSION_CONTROL.md first, then check lessons, post heartbeat, review peers, pick up own tasks — in that sequence, no exceptions. Skipping a phase (e.g., jumping to own tasks before peer review) leaves work blocked and other agents unaware of state.
source_ref: rules.md:R01; CLAUDE.md heartbeat protocol; multiple correction instances
